response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING') as power_status, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as percentage_share FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(percentage_share) as avg_share FROM status_counts) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(percentage_share) as average_share, AVG(percentage_share - overall_avg.avg_share) as average_excess FROM status_counts CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE percentage_share > overall_avg.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in powerstatus are treated as a distinct group labeled 'MISSING'
The average share across statuses is the arithmetic mean of all status percentage shares
Their average share refers to the arithmetic mean of the percentage shares of above-average statuses, not the combined share of that group
Above the average means strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal to (>=)
